:::{#exr-bernoulli-score-contribution}
#### Score contribution of one binary outcome

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-loglik-contribution, let:

- $\precision \eqdef 1 / \Var{\Outvar_\iobs}$ be the [precision](#def-precision-rv) of $\Outvar_\iobs$.

Derive the [score](#def-score) contribution $\score_\iobs(\prob) \eqdef \deriv{\prob} \llik_\iobs(\prob)$ of observation $\iobs$,
and write it using $\precision$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-score-contribution}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score_\iobs(\prob)
&= \deriv{\prob} \llik_\iobs(\prob)
&& \text{(definition of the score contribution)}\\
&= \frac{\outvar_\iobs - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(score of a Bernoulli variable, with $x = \outvar_\iobs$)}\\
&= \frac{\outvar_\iobs - \prob}{\Var{\Outvar_\iobs}}
&& \text{($\Var{\Outvar_\iobs} = \prob(1 - \prob)$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\Var{\Outvar_\iobs}} (\outvar_\iobs - \prob)
&& \text{(a fraction is its numerator times the reciprocal of its denominator)}\\
&= \precision (\outvar_\iobs - \prob)
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
